Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class ProfileService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.ProfileService
public final class ProfileService extends Object
Manage Profile (SRS UC-1.7): a signed-in buyer or seller changes their full name and, optionally, their password. Every check runs before anything changes; on success the account is saved and the admin is told which fields changed, never the password itself.

  • Method Details

    • updateProfile

      public List<String> updateProfile(User actor, String fullName, String currentPassword, String newPassword, String confirmPassword)
      Saves the profile. The password is changed only if any of the three password fields is filled in; then all three are checked.
      Returns:
      the fields that changed ("full name", "password"), empty if nothing changed
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active buyer or seller
      IllegalArgumentException - with the reason if a check fails (A1, A2); nothing changes

    • updateSellerProfile

      public List<String> updateSellerProfile(User actor, String fullName, String bio, Set<Location> meetup, String currentPassword, String newPassword, String confirmPassword)
      SRS UC-2.6: a seller changes their full name, bio, preferred meet-up locations and, optionally, their password. Every check runs before anything changes; on success the account is saved in one transaction and every admin is told which fields changed, never the password itself.
      Returns:
      the fields that changed in a fixed order, empty if nothing changed
      Throws:
      SecurityException - if actor is not an active seller
      IllegalArgumentException - with the reason if a check fails; nothing changes
